name: TechMind Multilingual Final Independent Benchmark v1
purpose: Final independent evaluation of the frozen TechMind v1.2.0-multilingual candidate; do not tune architecture or thresholds on these results.
methodology_notes: Each semantic case has controlled ES, EN, RU, and ES/EN variants.
The benchmark is separate from the earlier 80-row multilingual development benchmark.
Do not change model architecture, C, OOD threshold 0.4266, or decision-margin threshold 0.8132 after inspecting these results.
Counterfactual development examples are not included.
